use_rule: Reference for the Mission Router and explainer copy. Windows marked statutory_window are deadlines that would bind a veteran, so they may only reach a user as a deadline after a named reviewer verifies them against the cited authority (deadlines must cite a source: CHECK statutory_deadline_cites_source in the v2.0 schema). Task copy in task_library.py stays free of amounts and deadlines (content-safety lint).

windows.item: Begin TAP (pre-separation counseling) no later than 365 days before separation.
TAP Capstone verification at least 90 days before separation.
Benefits Delivery at Discharge (pre-discharge VA claim) window.
SGLI coverage continues at no cost for 120 days after separation.
Convert SGLI to VGLI within 240 days without medical underwriting.
Military OneSource remains available for 365 days after separation (modelled as an expiring right in Next Best Action band 2).

windows.offset: election at retirement; irrevocable after the one-year window

windows.item: Leave sell-back limited to 60 days over a career.
An Intent to File preserves the effective date for one year (the platform tracks the expiry; it never files).
Last day to apply for VGLI after separation (proof of good health is needed after day 240).
A disability claim received within 1 year of separation can take the day after separation as its effective date.
Request a Higher-Level Review or Board Appeal within 1 year of the decision letter; a Supplemental Claim filed within 1 year keeps the original effective date.
